source_policy: CrossWire text + native SWORD index for five authors; HelloAO for Gill and missing chapters
source_integrity: Raw SWORD content_osis, source SHA, author, verse anchors, rights and source version are preserved in all entry records
reader_policy: Nonverse front matter is separately identified and not automatically included in verse reader; no inference, review, or editorial text rewriting.
compatibility: Jake and future commentaries may use same labels with their own provenance and status; this publication contains historical authors only.
notes: Book and chapter navigation uses P identifiers not Scripture verse zero.
Prefatory splits require explicit source headings/section markers; unresolved records remain available as originals.
Original v1 and v2 APIs are not replaced; this is a separate review pilot.
Author lifetimes, geographic associations, and publication dates have distinct named fields with source URLs.
